title: Homogeneity of uniform expectation
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, $c\in\mathbb R$, and real-valued function $f$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, the uniform expectation satisfies $\mathbb E_x[c f(x)]=c\,\mathbb E_x[f(x)]$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $c\in\mathbb R$, and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$.
Then $\mathbb E[cf]=c\mathbb E[f]$, where $(cf)(x)=cf(x)$ and
$\mathbb E[h]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}h(x)$.
